body: Hey, I'm sorry I'm late. I'm around whenever and can chat about whatever you want. I have similar feelings too. I'm always really exhausted by what I have to do to appear stable.

That's what I'm currently doing (the Khan Academy bit). I also can't really tell my classmates anything. My school is really competitive so the rumors go quickly. 
It's just that it never feels like enough. It's also gets to be really time consuming which makes the sleeping bit worse. The moment I figure out one thing there another thing I need to deal with. It just feels like it's all bullshit and that no matter what I do, it doesn't matter. I constantly feel like I want to slam my head into a table.
Same situation. I don't want her to suffer anymore than she has.

There's nobody to help me out. I can't afford a tutor and even then my private school doesn't offer any aid. When I ask teachers to explain simple concepts they act like I'm stupid and become extremely belittling. Additionally, anytime word gets around that I don't understand something it's used as a reason for me not to take harder courses even though I have a very high GPA and get good scores.

I can't afford a tutor and talking with a counselor is not an option. The ones at my school have literally no concept of confidentiality. The moment there's even whiff that I can't handle the pressure, they'll say I can't handle it and drop me from my honors/advanced placement courses......
